about_page.title: About us
about_page.subtitle: Connect Morocco, one listing at a time.

story.title: Founded with a simple yet ambitious vision
story.p1: MarocAdsZone has become Morocco's leading online listings platform, providing a secure and efficient space to buy, sell, and promote services with confidence.
story.p2: From the beginning, we have been committed to :
story.li1: Simplifying the buying and selling process for individuals and businesses.
story.li2: Building a bridge between sellers and buyers, without barriers or unnecessary complexity.
story.li3: Offering a reliable channel so that every listing generates visibility and real opportunities.

engagements.title: A secure, intuitive and high-performing platform
engagements.card1_p: Create and publish your listings in just a few clicks.
engagements.card2_p: Reach a qualified audience across Morocco.
engagements.card3_p: All listings are verified to ensure the platform's reliability.
engagements.card4_p: Our dedicated support is here to guide you and meet your needs.

mission.title: Make access to the Moroccan market easier
mission.p1: We believe every project deserves visibility and every seller should be able to reach their audience easily.
mission.p2: We actively contribute to strengthening the local economy by helping Moroccan individuals and businesses sell, rent, and promote their services faster and more effectively.
mission.card1_p: MarocAdsZone verifies listings and profiles to ensure the quality of published content.
mission.card2_p: Post your listings whenever you want, according to your priorities.
mission.card3_p: Help you turn every listing into a real opportunity.
mission.cta_p: Become part of a dynamic community of buyers and sellers, and give new momentum to your sales and services.
